text.text: NetApp E5400 modular data storage systems support big-bandwidth datasets requiring high sequential throughput. The NetApp ® E5400 storage system meets your organization’s demanding performance and capacity requirements without sacrificing simplicity and efficiency. Its balanced performance supports high-performance file systems, bandwidth-intensive streaming applications, and transaction-intensive workloads. The E5400 multiple drive shelf options enable custom configurations for any environment.
